allies_win: Enemy fighters have been eliminated. Scans indicate last few remaining Coynite vessels fleeing the system.
battle_abandoned: ¡Dejaste al 701st solo! No tendrán mucha oportunidad contra la fuerza superior. Informa tu fracaso a tu comandante.
battle_started: ¡Advertencia! TIE 701st wing engaging enemy. Highly outnumbered.
enemies_win: TIE 701st wing has been destroyed. Thier destuction means loss of control in system. Report to your superior immediately.
found_loc: We have located the squadron. Travel immediately to their location and assist them in the destruction of the enemy. Keep the 701st alive, they are essential to the protection of the Dathomir sector.
quest_findbattle_d: Meet the 701st at the supplied navigation waypoint and wait for the arrival of the enemy.
quest_helpallies_d: You must destroy all the enemy attacking vessels before they can destroy the remaining TIEs in the 701st.
quest_location_d: The attack is taking place in the Dathomir system. A navigaiton waypoint will be supplied to you.
title: Dathomir System: Battle the Coynite Fighters
title_d: The Coynite have attacked the 701st TIE wing over Dathomir. That TIE defense force is highly important for the security of the Dathomir system and must be keep alive. Assist the 701st in its defense against the Coynite.
